description: Refused upgrade whose HTTP status the SDK cannot observe (MCPWARP.md §1 Upgrade-status mapping, §6.7 T27; D-2026-10-14-07 R5): the edge refuses with 401, but the factory reports only a failed dial (dial_failed without httpStatus), indistinguishable from a network failure. connecting + RETRYING, never error/UNAUTHORIZED; a second refusal keeps RETRYING (no snapshot); the redial then goes online. Companion of 36_t32_http_401_upgrade_unauthorized.
